Commands from root. MODEL=Composer Standard. Sequential T-IDs. Parent forwards one card and named anchors; receipt: T-ID, files, test/count, negative result, contradiction if any. No live runs.

Move src/adapters/redis-store.ts→src/redis/redis-store.ts; src/runtime/redis-config.ts→src/redis/redis-config.ts; src/runtime/redis-connection.ts→src/redis/redis-connection.ts; src/resilience/redis-circuit-breaker.ts→src/redis/redis-circuit-breaker.ts. Preserve all public subpath exports and symbols. Retain temporary reexports at old private paths only if tracked external imports actually exist; parent checks exact old import strings including distributed harness and verification tools, update mechanical paths only, stop for external contract change. pnpm --filter @offscreen/cache test.

T02 | Envelope. Anchors redis/redis-store.ts, new redis/envelope.ts, redis-store.test.ts. Move EnvelopeV1, REDIS_ENTRY_MAX_BYTES, size constants, base64 predicate, encodeEnvelope/decodeEnvelope unchanged to envelope.ts; reexport REDIS_ENTRY_MAX_BYTES from redis-store for existing private tests. Preserve v/p/o/e JSON order, empty payload, 1MiB maximum, raw length limit, accepted base64 pattern, invalid/expired/oversize mapping, timestamps and defensive copy. No format upgrade or stricter base64 semantics. Replace unchecked parsed object assertion with explicit property validation only if acceptance identical (extra fields remain accepted); otherwise keep scoped invariant comment. Test existing malformed, size, expiry, zero-byte and round-trip cases. Run package tests.

T03 | Shared command executor. Anchors redis/redis-store.ts, redis/redis-circuit-breaker.ts, new redis/command-executor.ts, bounded-cache.test.ts. Extract one per-store executor holding outstanding counter, breaker and timeout controller. Interface execute<T>(dispatch:(signal:AbortSignal)=>Promise<T>):Promise<{kind:'ok',value:T}|{kind:'bypass',reason:'unavailable'|'circuit-open'|'saturated'|'timeout'}>; outstandingCount():number. Admission preserves breaker.admit before preflight, connection readiness before deny before capacity, startProbe only after all pass. Register outstanding before invoking SDK; catch synchronous throw; deadline aborts signal, reports breaker failure once, resolves caller timeout; late success/failure must not alter breaker again; actual settlement releases slot and clears timer in finally, never caller timeout. Preserve timer unref and defaults 100ms/256; injected breaker unchanged. No cancellation guarantee for SDK. Store GET maps null→miss, decodes on success; SET validates size/expiry before executor and prepares wire before dispatch (no wire change), maps ok→stored. Preserve __outstanding test seam. Use one common typed bypass without casts. If envelope decode throws unexpectedly, map unavailable without reporting a second connectivity result; ordinary malformed data remains invalid. Tests GET and SET deferred SDK timeout retains capacity, late reject/success exactly one breaker report, saturation no dispatch, half-open only one probe, sync throw cleanup, malformed response not connectivity failure. Run package tests.

T04 | Adapter readability. Anchors cache-adapter.ts, redis/redis-connection.ts, cache-adapter.test.ts. Extract command capture + createRedisStoreCommands into redis/adapter-commands.ts, legacy JSON cache + its deadline into legacy-read-cache.ts. Root adapter remains composition only; preserve startupReady/legacy disabled semantics, settings parsing, injected factory/timers, incident swallowing and close behavior. No SDK promise race inside createRedisStoreCommands. Test existing adapter and cache-boundary-regressions. Parent README update, package typecheck/test, public build exports remain identical. No reconnect state-machine redesign in this Change.
